mainImage.alt: Palestinians inspect the site of an overnight Israeli strike on a medical supply warehouse near Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir el-Balah, central Gaza Strip, August 1, 2026
mainImage.caption: Palestinians inspect the site of an overnight Israeli strike on a medical supply warehouse near Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir el-Balah, August 1, 2026. The attack destroyed four medicine warehouses holding IV fluids, dialysis supplies, and intensive care equipment.

body.alt: Mourners carry the body of a Palestinian killed in an Israeli airstrike in Gaza, August 2026
body.caption: Mourners in Gaza carry the body of a Palestinian killed in Israeli airstrikes during the week of August 1-3, 2026, as attacks escalated despite the Board of Peace announcing a disarmament agreement.

body.alt: Gaza Civil Defense teams work to recover bodies from the rubble of the al-Hasayna family homes in Sabra neighborhood, Gaza City, August 2026
body.caption: Palestinian Civil Defense teams recover bodies from the ruins of the al-Hasayna family homes in Sabra, south of Gaza City, August 1, 2026. Crews recovered 112 bodies including 40 children and 38 women after 136 hours of digging, largely by hand.
